nodes.label: Plan Mode
nodes.rationale: Breaks complex multi-step tasks into structured, reviewable plans so the user has full visibility and control (approve/reject/cancel) before anything executes; tasks run sequentially in validated dependency order with circular-dependency rejection.

nodes.label: PLAN.md Export
nodes.rationale: Auto-generated on approval as living documentation of tasks and implementation steps; overwritten by each new approval, so users must rename plans they want to keep.

nodes.label: Plan Status Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Draft -> PendingApproval -> Approved -> InProgress -> Completed, with Rejected/Cancelled branches; plans persist in SQLite plus JSON backup so they survive restarts and stay session-isolated.
